p0_findings.finding: No fixed-seed random campaign exists and V03 does not hit just-below, at, and just-above either Q24 rail. The extreme profile only produces -8551150, -8226025, 8226030, and 8551155; equality profile only tests 7>=7.
p0_findings.required_fix: Add independent random cases and the six exact wide-sum rail cases 8388606/8388607/8388608 and -8388609/-8388608/-8388607.

p0_findings.finding: The V06 task force-sets internal ready/owned/order at negedge, checks a combinational mux after #1, then resets; it does not prove an issue edge, ownership transition, selected tag/payload, or first result.
p0_findings.required_fix: Create a sequential oldest-bank test and matching oldest-selection/ownership SVA plus nonzero dual-ready cover.

p0_findings.finding: release_valid is asserted only after send_tiles has completed all raw ingress. Partial-raw and explicit dense cycle0/12/16 held-release cases are absent.
p0_findings.required_fix: Add separate held-release attacks for partial raw, cycle0, cycle12, cycle16, and FIFO-only drain, each with exactly one post-drain accept/retire.

p0_findings.finding: Only partial config, partial raw, and dense cycle5 are reset. Dense close/tail, FIFO close stall, quarantine, deterministic state checks, and clean next context are absent.
p0_findings.required_fix: Reset at representative prologue/close/tail phases, FIFO-full close stall, and quarantine; prove empty state and run a clean exact N1 context after every reset.

p0_findings.finding: Raw ownership conservation, oldest selection, complete close-stall atomic hold, exact FIFO conservation, phase12/phase16 stall, all five beats, zero-tile fault, reset recovery and accepted X/Z gates are absent. ap_close_stall_holds can be bypassed when credit is high in the consequent cycle.
p0_findings.required_fix: Expose the needed bind state, assert the full state bundle with $past, add conservation/oldest properties, and require every sealed cover to have a nonzero match.

p0_findings.finding: The runner does not self-check an externally frozen runner SHA, does not automatically seal/cross-link its negative preflight, and still emits a V01-V20 PASS. The draft contract renumbers and narrows multiple tests relative to the sealed specification.
p0_findings.required_fix: Add runner self-SHA, an automatic separate-directory wrong-SHA control with exit10/no compile/no positive receipt, cross-link it in the positive receipt, and restore exact sealed V01-V20 semantics.

p1_findings.finding: The current M518 and M273 default public ports are exact, but the runner does not hash or mechanically compare the canonical 50-port signature.
The receipt tool version is a constant string and the runner does not record/check the actual vcs -ID output.
busy, tile_done_tag/exactly-once, and debug_context_cycles versus retire count are not strongly asserted.
Run manifests should use stable relative member paths and a uniform outer seal for the final publication set.

decision.reason: A positive run could claim sealed V01-V20 while omitting or weakening multiple mandatory tests and launcher identity controls.
re_review_gate: contract exactly preserves sealed V01-V20 semantics
runner self-SHA and sealed negative preflight cross-link implemented
all mandatory assertion covers required nonzero
new exact production identities receive independent r2 static review
